pharma.title: CDSCO to reject long-pending online applications after three reminders
pharma.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) announced that long-pending online regulatory applications will be rejected if applicants fail to respond after receiving three reminders.

pharma.title: Venus Remedies Antibiotic Approved in Argentina
pharma.summary: Indian pharmaceutical firm Venus Remedies secured regulatory approval in Argentina for its essential antibiotic product, expanding its Latin American presence.

pharma.title: IPA urges Union health minister to withdraw new DCGI recruitment rules
pharma.summary: The Indian Pharmaceutical Association (IPA) urged the Union Health Minister to withdraw the newly framed recruitment rules for the Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI), citing statutory non-compliance.

pharma.title: GIMS Launches Uttar Pradesh’s First MEDTECH Regulatory Clinic
pharma.summary: The Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS) launched Uttar Pradesh's first MEDTECH Regulatory Clinic to provide regulatory support and guidance to healthcare startups.

national.title: Repatriation of illegal Bangladeshis is a core issue: MEA
national.summary: India's Ministry of External Affairs affirmed that the repatriation of illegal Bangladeshi migrants remains a core bilateral priority following remarks from Dhaka regarding push-ins.

national.title: Govt's E85, E100 push tests ethanol supply and storage limits
national.summary: The central government's policy push toward higher ethanol fuel blends such as E85 and E100 is putting strain on the country's current supply chain and storage infrastructure.

international.title: India, Vietnam elevate ties to enhanced comprehensive strategic partnership
international.summary: India and Vietnam officially upgraded their bilateral relation to an Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and signed 13 key cooperation agreements across multiple sectors.

international.title: Rubio to visit India for bilateral talks ahead of Quad meeting
international.summary: US diplomatic representatives confirmed an official visit to India for high-level bilateral talks ahead of the Quad Foreign Ministers' meeting scheduled for late May.

international.title: WHO response to hantavirus cases linked to cruise ship
international.summary: The World Health Organization monitored and released guidance following reported cases of hantavirus infection linked to passengers on a cruise ship.

economy.title: States’ GDP calculation revamped: Govt issues uniform GSDP norms
economy.summary: The Union Government issued updated uniform Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) calculation guidelines for states, fixing 2022-23 as the new base year.

economy.title: Apple, CleanMax partner on India green push
economy.summary: Apple partnered with renewable energy developer CleanMax to expand clean energy projects and advance green manufacturing operations across India.

economy.title: RBI likely to hold rates in June, says HSBC Chief India Economist
economy.summary: Analysts at HSBC projected that the Reserve Bank of India will likely maintain policy rates unchanged during its upcoming June Monetary Policy Committee meeting.

science.title: India and Japan sign quantum technology and healthcare cooperation agreements
science.summary: India and Japan exchanged official memorandums of understanding to deepen bilateral cooperation in quantum technology, frontier technologies, and medical devices.

science.title: Google launches Fitbit Air wrist strap for AI health tracking
science.summary: Google introduced Fitbit Air, a health tracking wrist strap that utilizes artificial intelligence to monitor personal health metrics.

environment.title: Supreme Court empowers District Collectors to enforce Solid Waste Management Rules
environment.summary: The Supreme Court of India issued directions empowering District Collectors to strictly enforce the Solid Waste Management Rules within their local jurisdictions.

environment.title: Telangana prepares for heatwave amid Super El Nino risks
environment.summary: State authorities in Telangana initiated heatwave preparedness plans to mitigate health and urban climate risks driven by shifting weather patterns and Super El Nino concerns.

sports.title: U-17 Indian girls confirm 12 medals at Asian Boxing Championships
sports.summary: India's Under-17 women's boxing squad secured 12 medals at the Asian Boxing U-15 & U-17 Championships.

awards_honours.title: Two Indian Women Honoured With 'Green Oscars' For Conservation
awards_honours.summary: Two Indian female conservationists were awarded the prestigious Whitley Awards, popularly known as the 'Green Oscars', recognizing their grassroots wildlife protection efforts.

awards_honours.title: e4m NEXT-AI Awards launched to honour AI-powered marketing innovations
awards_honours.summary: Exchange4Media launched the e4m NEXT-AI Awards to celebrate and acknowledge innovative artificial intelligence applications in marketing.

awards_honours.title: Century-old Indian family business wins Erth Dubai award
awards_honours.summary: A long-established Indian family enterprise was honored with the prestigious Erth Dubai award for enterprise sustainability and heritage.

defence.title: Dutch frigate to join Indian Navy for military exercise
defence.summary: A Royal Netherlands Navy frigate arrived in Indian waters to participate in a joint naval military exercise with the Indian Navy.

defence.title: India marks one year after Operation Sindoor
defence.summary: Defence analysts reviewed the operational and strategic shifts in India's war doctrine and defense readiness one year after the execution of Operation Sindoor.

schemes_appointments.title: Centre launches scheme for free health check-ups for workers
schemes_appointments.summary: The Union Government launched a national scheme to offer free routine health check-ups for formal and industrial workers.

schemes_appointments.title: Shashi Shekhar Vempati appointed CBFC Chairman
schemes_appointments.summary: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting appointed former Prasar Bharati CEO Shashi Shekhar Vempati as the new Chairperson of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC).

important_days.title: World Athletics Day 2026 Observed on May 07
important_days.summary: World Athletics Day 2026 was celebrated on May 7 with themes centered on breaking barriers, promoting physical activity, and strengthening global unity through sports.

mcqs.explanation: The central government issued uniform Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) calculation guidelines for states using 2022-23 as the new base year.

mcqs.explanation: Former Prasar Bharati CEO Shashi Shekhar Vempati was appointed as the Chairperson of the CBFC by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.

mcqs.explanation: A Royal Netherlands Navy (Dutch) frigate joined the Indian Navy for joint maritime exercises.

mcqs.explanation: World Athletics Day 2026 was observed on May 07, focusing on global unity and sports participation.
